name: JobBooker API
description: JobBooker turns leads into booked jobs for home-service businesses: it answers a new lead in seconds in the owner's voice, keeps the conversation going, books the job on the calendar, keeps contacts and conversations in one place, and runs each stage's follow-through. This API is how lead sources and automation tools hand JobBooker a lead or a message and receive replies and alerts back; Yelp through Zapier is the first source. Every endpoint is authenticated with the business's API key, shown in the JobBooker dashboard under Settings, Connect. Send it in the x-jobbooker-key header.
